title: Reading: The Knight's Tale, Lines 859–882
subtitle: The temple of Mars — Chaucer's high style.
objectives: Master Reading: The Knight's Tale, Lines 859–882.
Read and translate authentic Middle English texts.
Prepare for sustained reading in Stage 3.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: The description of the temple of Mars. Chaucer's high style. Latinate vocabulary and complex syntax. 'The statue of Mars upon a carte stood / Armed, and looked grym as he were wood...' Vocabulary: carte (chariot), grym (grim), wood (mad), statue, armed.

items.prompt: What is the focus of this lesson?
Can you apply this to reading?
items.answer: Work through examples with your notes.
